newsitem.title: USA: Disgraced adviser says Clinton gave him a boomerang.
newsitem.headline: Disgraced adviser says Clinton gave him a boomerang.

text.p: President Clinton may or may not want disgraced political adviser Dick Morris back on the job, but he sent Morris a boomerang as a Christmas present, Morris said in an interview aired on Saturday.
In the taped interview for the CNN programme "Evans & Novak," Morris refused to say whether he was still advising Clinton after having resigned in a scandal involving a prostitute last May.

But "he did give me a Christmas present, a heck of one," said Morris, who steered Clinton midway between liberal Democrats and conservative Republicans in Congress in a strategy known as "triangulation."
The president picked up a boomerang during a visit to Australia last year, "and he said 'this is in honour of triangulation,'" Morris said.
Clinton also told him the proper way to throw the boomerang was to "tilt it 10 degrees to the right," according to Morris, who is currently promoting a book on his White House experiences.
Morris resigned after a tabloid newspaper revealed that he had spent evenings with a prostitute whom he let eavesdrop on his telephone conversations with Clinton.
